character:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: single full-body game character equipment concept, transparent PNG, for MapleStory Worlds 2D chibi dark fantasy game '잡으면 내편'.
Primary request: create ONE original necromancer wearing a coherent six-piece equipment set called Ashen Veil. The character has pale porcelain gray skin, very long straight black hair reaching lower back, sharp tired violet eyes, a quietly defiant expression. Maple-style cute SD proportions: head roughly 40% of total height, small compact body, short limbs, a readable 2D sprite silhouette. Gender-neutral youthful adult, no child. A custom character, not a copied branded Demon Slayer hero.
Equipment design: (1) a soft ash-black cloth hood folded back around shoulders so hair and face remain visible, small tarnished brass clasp; (2) layered charcoal-gray worn linen long robe with asymmetric tattered hem, slim waist leather belt, a small oval dim violet rune clasp, simple raised collar, no steel chest plate; (3) wrapped fingerless dark leather gloves with one small bone rivet; (4) slim black leather ankle boots with cloth wraps and a tiny tarnished brass buckle; (5) compact bone-handled iron crescent scythe in right hand, nicked crescent blade, bound cloth grip and one small purple rune, not huge; (6) old handheld iron lantern with dim violet captured soul flame held in left hand, hexagonal simple iron cage, loop handle, three bone beads tied at neck. The six items share worn charcoal, smoky bone ivory and muted brass, with violet used sparingly. This is a collectible early rare/set outfit, not endgame regal armor.
Style/medium: polished 2D Maple-inspired pixel art with discrete visible pixel clusters and a restrained 24-color palette, selective dark outlines, stepped 4-level shading, no airbrush, no realism, no 3D. Make the intended base sprite about 96 pixels tall, shown enlarged with nearest-neighbor pixels; all contours follow the same pixel grid.
Composition/framing: exactly ONE complete character standing in neutral three-quarter front pose, head to boots visible, both weapons visible, centered with generous transparent margins. No environment, no ground plane, no shadow outside character.
Constraints: genuine alpha transparency, no text, no labels, no collage, no extra characters, no wings, no horns, no crown, no enormous shoulder plates, no skull helmet, no glow haze, no floating particles, no gradients in background. Hair visible and long. Both feet same baseline. Outfit proportions must remain usable as a MapleStory Worlds avatar reference.
